column_description: Full name of the user. may be NULL.
Email address of the user. may be NULL.
Role of the user (e.g., administrator, finance officer, policymaker). always exactly one of 'administrator', 'finance officer', 'policymaker'. may be NULL.
Phone number of the user. may be NULL.
Timestamp of the last login. may be NULL.
Status of the user (e.g., active, inactive). always exactly one of 'active', 'inactive'. may be NULL.
Timestamp when the user account was created. may be NULL.
Timestamp when the user account was last updated. may be NULL.
